preservedResponsibilities: Both original missing-converter fallbacks preserve native buffer, explicit source span, output capacity, conversion flags, status-cell and consumed-counter contracts. Byte-to-UTF16 conversion zero-extends unsigned bytes; reverse conversion retains each UTF16 unit low byte. Early undefined-error paths preserve prior status bits and leave consumed counters untouched.

Native text-to-Unicode descriptor/context API now dispatches the existing source converters, retaining null handles, the pointer-one stateless sentinel, real UTF8/UTF7/ISCII/ISO-2022 contexts, reset behavior, native flag admission and missing-converter fallback. Four direct HTML/SvParser tests and one factory/streaming dispatch test exercise the new consumer. Context storage is released by GC; this is not native pointer/allocation ABI parity.

Native reverse converter/context APIs now route every represented descriptor family to actual Unicode-to-text owners, preserving shared forward/reverse descriptor identity, unsigned16 IDs, null handles, stateless pointer-one context, original reverse flag assertion domain, reset/destruction guards and missing-converter fallback. JIS X0201 retains its source null forward callback; the JS binding throws instead of substituting a forward service for an undefined native call. Context memory uses GC and does not certify native pointer/allocation ABI. Generic checked string wrappers and unrepresented encoding families remain open.
omittedResponsibilities: Complete SAL registry families and native allocation/ABI/full service differential verification remain unverified. Checked string wrappers and Writer orchestration are separate pending owners.
